verdict.rationale: Folk's pricing lists 'Pipeline management' as a feature. Its docs say deals and other custom objects (Deals, Projects, Job Applications, Partnerships) are object types defined inside a group, which implies separate groups can hold separate pipelines for different motions. However, no evidence shows that each pipeline can carry its own configurable stage set. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multiple pipelines with distinct, configurable stages; evidence that stages differ per group or object type; hands-on or independent corroboration.
